_comment: Question-key parity vectors (docs/phase5-apply-agent-spec.md 6.5, 12.3, 12.5). 'key' is what OpportunityApplyEngine.questionKey(text) returns and what apply_policy.question_key(text) must return: lowercase, every run of characters outside [a-z0-9'] becomes one space, then trim. Node checks it in tests/extension/run_tests.mjs; the Python suites reuse this file.

vectors.text: Why do you want to work at Acme?
vectors.key: why do you want to work at acme

vectors.text: Why   do you want	to work at Acme?
vectors.key: why do you want to work at acme

vectors.text: WHY DO YOU WANT TO WORK AT ACME
vectors.key: why do you want to work at acme
